selection_blinding: Split membership was fixed from capture index and existing-label provenance before detector proposals, restoration outputs, or test metrics were consulted.
spatial_block_audit: Every frame in a later candidate block is at least 20 m from every frame in each earlier candidate block, preventing route revisits from placing the same pavement location in multiple splits.
existing_crid46_policy: All 46 previously inspected frames are assigned to training/development only.
coordinate_policy: Annotations are stored in native pixel coordinates.
telemetry_policy: All selected frames require synchronized Sony EXIF and complete 200 Hz SBG data; latitude/longitude are retained only for split and synchronization audit.
